"'''Red Seven'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew with the [[New Republic]]'s [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] at the [[Battle of Tandankin|mission on Tandankin]]<ref name="Rogue Squadron Special">''[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron Special]]''</ref> a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="X-Wing Omnibus 2">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: X-Wing Rogue Squadron Volume 2]]''</ref> [[Tandankin]] had been seized by [[Grand Moff]] [[Nigel Nivers|Nivers]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] when the Rogues, flying with "Red" callsigns, struck. A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|big gun]] took out Red Seven's [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]], forcing an emergency crash landing, where the pilot discovered a landing strip of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. He informed [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who shot down a [[Tandankin monument|tower]] to crush the TIEs. Nivers was captured, and the New Republic won the day.<ref name="Rogue Squadron Special" />
